title: The Mute Guards and Silent Court
hook: Inside the Sultan's private courtyard, speaking aloud was banned.

scenes.text: Inside the innermost Third Courtyard of Topkapi Palace, absolute silence was strictly enforced by imperial decree.
scenes.imagePrompt: Third Courtyard of Topkapi Palace with manicured gardens, serene marble colonnades, and bronze fountains under midday light. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Inside the innermost Third Courtyard of Topkapi Palace, absolute silence was strictly enforced by imperial decree.

scenes.text: Speaking above a whisper was considered grave disrespect to the Sultan, and footsteps were muffled by thick wool carpets.
scenes.imagePrompt: Grand imperial corridor paved with exquisite Iznik blue ceramic tiles and carpeted with long crimson silk runners. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Speaking above a whisper was considered grave disrespect to the Sultan, and footsteps were muffled by thick wool carpets.

scenes.text: To protect state secrets, the Sultan's personal bodyguards and attendants were deaf and mute men known as 'dilsizler'.
scenes.imagePrompt: Ornate carved wooden palace doorway with mother-of-pearl inlay and heavy brass hanging knocker in quiet shadow. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: To protect state secrets, the Sultan's personal bodyguards and attendants were deaf and mute men known as 'dilsizler'.

scenes.text: Because they could neither overhear sensitive war discussions nor reveal secrets under torture, they were trusted completely.
scenes.imagePrompt: Imperial council chamber table with scroll maps, wax seals, and jeweled inkpots beneath gilded ceiling domes. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Because they could neither overhear sensitive war discussions nor reveal secrets under torture, they were trusted completely.

scenes.text: The court developed a sophisticated sign language called 'Iksarat', allowing ministers to debate military treaties entirely without voice.
